title: Zul'jan and Hex Lord Malacrass timed-mechanic context

source.title: Serpent's Bargain / Usurper's Reprisal / The Claimed Vessel / Coiled Union
source.notes: Curated for timer relevance. Numeric damage values were intentionally omitted.

phases.name: Coiled Union
phases.guide_transition: Soulbound marks the combined final stage.

mechanics.name: Fangs of the Coiled Altar
mechanics.summary: Channel that creates a repeated raid event, empowers subsequent melee attacks, and creates ground hazards.

timer_policy.reason: Primary boss cast suitable for a timer only if repeated pulls show stable cast timing.

mechanics.name: Twinfang Toxin
mechanics.summary: Follow-up tank pressure whose applications are consumed by melee attacks.

timer_policy.reason: Track as an aura consequence of Fangs rather than as an independent pull timer.

mechanics.name: Noxious Ground
mechanics.summary: Expanding ground hazard created beneath altar mouths.

timer_policy.reason: Location is dynamic; display from live ground-effect or position evidence.

mechanics.name: Toxic Deluge
mechanics.summary: Primary cast that creates venom impact locations and persistent globule mechanics.

timer_policy.reason: Warn for the parent cast when log observations establish stable occurrence times.

mechanics.name: Coalesced Venom
mechanics.summary: Persistent globule created by Toxic Deluge and recreated after player interaction.

timer_policy.reason: Spawn and destruction timing depend on player actions.

mechanics.name: Venom Rupture
mechanics.summary: Raid-wide consequence triggered by globule destruction; behavior varies by difficulty.

timer_policy.reason: Emit from the destruction trigger, not from an encounter-relative schedule.

mechanics.name: Volatile Venom
mechanics.summary: Player-carried proximity effect that recreates a globule when it expires.

timer_policy.reason: Use aura application and expiration events for personal warnings.

mechanics.name: Virulent Cyst
mechanics.summary: Mythic globule mutation that periodically creates more Coalesced Venoms.

timer_policy.reason: Its existence depends on the active Mythic variant and Toxic Deluge result.

mechanics.name: Caustic Secretion
mechanics.summary: Cyst ability that repeatedly creates two Coalesced Venoms.

timer_policy.reason: A source-relative timer may start after a Virulent Cyst is observed; do not anchor it to pull time.

mechanics.name: Virulent Mutation
mechanics.summary: Mythic globule variant with player-driven chain-reaction behavior.

timer_policy.reason: Spawn and detonation timing are dynamic.

mechanics.name: Guillotine
mechanics.summary: Targeted soak followed by an axe eruption; failed participation causes Execution.

timer_policy.reason: Warn for the boss cast when repeated logs show stable timing.

mechanics.name: Execution
mechanics.summary: Failure event when Guillotine does not hit enough players.

timer_policy.reason: Report as a failed-soak consequence rather than predict it.

mechanics.name: Widow's Kiss
mechanics.summary: Delayed eruption associated with the Guillotine axe.

timer_policy.reason: Learn an offset from observed Guillotine or axe events rather than from pull time.

mechanics.name: Sever
mechanics.summary: Tank frontal that also destroys venom objects.

timer_policy.reason: Can receive a tank warning if casts are stable, but should not be promoted as raid-wide damage.

mechanics.name: Venomfang
mechanics.summary: Axe attack that travels between several players and applies a timed effect.

timer_policy.reason: Parent cast may be timed from logs; the effect tick interval is not a cast interval.

mechanics.name: Axegrinder
mechanics.summary: Creates moving axes that persist in the arena; Mythic axes do not despawn.

timer_policy.reason: Warn for the initial cast only when timing is stable; movement remains live-map data.

mechanics.name: Dreadmarch
mechanics.summary: Possesses multiple players and creates Manifestations when removed.

timer_policy.reason: Warn for Malacrass casts if pull-relative timing is stable; manifestation-applied copies remain reactive.

mechanics.name: Manifestation of Dread
mechanics.summary: Fixating add created by Dreadmarch with additional Mythic visibility and collision rules.

timer_policy.reason: A source-relative refixate timer may begin after the add is observed on Mythic.

mechanics.name: Soul Sever
mechanics.summary: Tank frontal that applies Gravebound and interacts with Manifestations.

timer_policy.reason: Use as a tank timer if repeated casts are stable.

mechanics.name: Gravebound
mechanics.summary: Requires recovery of Soul Fragments before expiration.

timer_policy.reason: Start a personal expiration timer from the aura event, not from pull time.

mechanics.name: Eternal Nightfall
mechanics.summary: Devastating cast that can be interrupted after its shield is broken.

timer_policy.reason: High-priority advance warning if cast-start timing is stable.

mechanics.name: Veil of Twilight
mechanics.summary: Shield protecting Eternal Nightfall and repeatedly applying Suffocating Darkness.

timer_policy.reason: Track shield state from live events under the Eternal Nightfall callout.

mechanics.name: Spiritcackle
mechanics.summary: Summons Soulcoilers whose behavior varies by difficulty.

timer_policy.reason: Warn for add waves if the summoning cast is stable.

mechanics.name: Wail of Terror
mechanics.summary: Interruptible Soulcoiler cast that fears players if completed.

timer_policy.reason: Use cast-start events for immediate interrupt callouts, optionally learning source-relative cadence.

mechanics.name: Gloombomb
mechanics.summary: Marks players, then explodes after a short delay; higher difficulties add Gravebound interactions.

timer_policy.reason: Warn for stable applications and use aura expiration for the personal countdown.

mechanics.name: Dread Bolt
mechanics.summary: Primary-target filler attack.

timer_policy.reason: Do not create a timer unless future evidence identifies a separate actionable pattern.

mechanics.name: Soulbinding
mechanics.summary: Begins the intermission and applies Ghastly Regeneration while fragments attempt to return.

timer_policy.reason: Use the observed cast or aura as an authoritative phase trigger.

mechanics.name: Ghastly Regeneration
mechanics.summary: Timed intermission healing window with increased boss vulnerability.

timer_policy.reason: Start a phase-relative duration timer when the aura is observed.

mechanics.name: Fragment of Malacrass
mechanics.summary: Fragments travel toward Zul'jan and must be intercepted.

timer_policy.reason: Track from spawn and position data rather than a fixed schedule.

mechanics.name: Reclaim Essence
mechanics.summary: Failure event when a fragment reaches Zul'jan.

timer_policy.reason: Report after the fragment reaches the boss; do not predict it.

mechanics.name: Deathguard
mechanics.summary: Malacrass absorbs stunned Manifestations and becomes heavily protected.

timer_policy.reason: State depends on add control and should be detected from live events.

mechanics.name: Soulbound
mechanics.summary: Links the two bosses for the final stage with difficulty-specific behavior.

timer_policy.reason: Use the observed aura as the final-stage trigger.

mechanics.name: Defilement of the Coiled Altar
mechanics.summary: Final-stage altar cast that creates healing pressure, empowers melee follow-ups, and creates ground hazards.

timer_policy.reason: High-priority warning if log timing is stable.

mechanics.name: Corrupted Toxin
mechanics.summary: Final-stage melee follow-up applied by Defilement.

timer_policy.reason: Track as an aura consequence of Defilement.

mechanics.name: Defiled Ground
mechanics.summary: Final-stage ground hazard that applies repeated healing absorption.

timer_policy.reason: Location is dynamic and belongs in live map context.

mechanics.name: Grim Guillotine
mechanics.summary: Final-stage soak with healing pressure, a failed-soak consequence, and delayed eruption.

timer_policy.reason: High-priority warning if the parent cast timing is stable.

mechanics.name: Grim Execution
mechanics.summary: Failure event when Grim Guillotine does not hit enough players.

timer_policy.reason: Report as a failed-soak consequence rather than predict it.

mechanics.name: Death's Embrace
mechanics.summary: Delayed eruption associated with the Grim Guillotine axe.

timer_policy.reason: Learn an offset from observed Grim Guillotine or axe events.

mechanics.name: Blighted Sever
mechanics.summary: Final-stage tank frontal that applies Gravebound and clears encounter objects.

timer_policy.reason: Use as a tank warning if repeated casts are stable.
